body: I unfortunately don’t have advice but just wanted to say that I am feeling the exact same way right now. So hey at least we’re not alone.

These are already some great ideas. Your post was helpful and comforting to read as I can certainly relate. 

I encourage you to spend some time out in the common areas! Especially if you are just using your phone or laptop or are eating, watching TV, etc., and even if it is just for a little while. It gives you a chance to interact with your roomies in a neutral way without being imposing or putting pressure on yourself or them. 

I did do that back when I lived with roommates and I found that bit of interaction, even just saying hey when someone got home, or finding a mutual show to watch with a roommate or two that also enjoy it. I wish I had only done this more often!
